issue.title: Refresh stale beads sidecar README generated by init repo
issue.description: Discovered while verifying unrelated task bead sase-hl on 2026-08-08. just check passed formatting, keep-sorted, Ruff, mypy, pyscripts, changelog, Symvision, and toobig, then failed at the SASE validation stage because sase validate reported init repo --check needs to refresh sidecar guide files: sase/repos/beads/README.md would change by +1 -1 for the beads sidecar README. This was not caused by sase-hl, whose worktree has no primary-repo changes; focused selection-health tests and the flake baseline gate pass. Scope: refresh the generated beads sidecar README with the repo-init workflow, commit it through the normal sidecar path, and verify sase validate and just check no longer stop on this generated-guide drift.
